title: My Brother Stole My 401K-Funded Business And Gave Me $5K. So I Let Him Wear 'Bent The Truth'
description: After I drained my 401(k) to co-found a neon sign shop with my brother, he forged my signature, sold the company for $400K, and handed me a $5K check. But I found our original agreement in our late mother's Bible, voided the sale, and now he bends glass tubes in a vest that reads 'Bent the Truth' while every order ships with the fraud docket. #FamilyBetrayal #NeonSigns #GlowingBetrayal
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY BUSINESS. NOW HE WEARS 'BENT THE TRUTH'
pinned_comment: If your brother drained your 401(k), stole your business, and handed you a $5,000 check, would you have made him wear a vest that says 'Bent the Truth' or done something else? Tell me your story in the comments.
